Offload Unused Apps engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume storage-management features in the app cover storefront language. iOS Settings, storage APIs, and App Store Connect actually separate on-device offload behavior from product-page copy:

  • Settings → General → iPhone Storage — system screen listing every app by storage size with Offload App and Delete App actions per row. Your listing may show this screen on screenshots; teaching buyers where offload lives is listing copy, not engineering work.
  • Offload Unused Apps toggle — system-wide automatic offload when storage is low. Removes app binaries for apps the buyer has not used recently while keeping documents and data. zh-Hans Settings labels this 卸载未使用的 App. Does not generate Chinese listing text by itself.
  • Offload App (single app) — per-app action on the iPhone Storage list or Home Screen delete sheet. Removes one app binary while keeping that app's data. zh-Hans UI uses 卸载 App. Distinct from the bulk automatic toggle in marketing scope.
  • Delete App / Remove App — full uninstall that removes the app and its data. zh-Hans UI uses 删除 App or 移除 App. Listing copy must not conflate delete and offload when both appear on the same screenshot.
  • Reinstall from App Store — offloaded apps show a cloud-download badge and reinstall when tapped. Your description may mention one-tap restore; implementing reinstall UX is platform behavior — distinct from zh-Hans caption lines.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of storage features in the binary.

A working Offload Unused Apps story on device and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Offload App vs Delete App per row

iPhone Storage list screenshots often show two actions per app. 卸载 App maps to Offload App — remove binary, keep data. 删除 App maps to Delete App — full uninstall. Do not collapse both into one generic 删除 when your gallery shows both buttons on the same row.

Offload Unused Apps toggle vs single-app offload

Gallery frames differ — a Settings toggle for automatic bulk offload versus a single app's Offload App button on the storage list. Chinese buyers expect accurate scope: 卸载未使用的 App for the system toggle, 卸载 App for one-app action — not interchangeable vocabulary on the same product page.

Reinstall cloud badge

Offloaded apps show a cloud download icon on the Home Screen. zh-Hans caption lines may use 从 App Store 重新安装 or 轻点重新下载 when your frame shows the reinstall workflow — honest scope when your English listing already claims it.

Do not conflate with Optimize iPhone Storage

Optimize iPhone Storage manages photo library device copies under iCloud Photos — 优化 iPhone 储存空间. Offload Unused Apps removes app binaries under General → iPhone Storage — 卸载未使用的 App. If your app covers both, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

FAQ

What is Offload Unused Apps and where do buyers find it?

Offload Unused Apps is under Settings → General → iPhone Storage → Offload Unused Apps. When enabled, iOS automatically removes unused app binaries while keeping documents and data. Simplified Chinese Settings labels the toggle 卸载未使用的 App.

Does enabling Offload Unused Apps auto-translate my China listing?

No. The toggle and per-app Offload App actions control on-device storage — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

How is Offload Unused Apps different from Offload App on one app?

Offload App is a per-app action on the iPhone Storage list or Home Screen delete sheet — 卸载 App. Offload Unused Apps is the system-wide automatic toggle — 卸载未使用的 App. Listing copy must match which workflow your screenshots show.

How is Offload App different from Delete App?

Offload App removes the binary but keeps data — 卸载 App. Delete App uninstalls the app and removes its data — 删除 App or 移除 App. Do not collapse both into one term when your gallery shows both actions.

How is Offload Unused Apps different from Optimize iPhone Storage?

Optimize iPhone Storage is an iCloud Photos setting — 优化 iPhone 储存空间 — that manages photo library device copies. Offload Unused Apps removes app binaries under General → iPhone Storage — 卸载未使用的 App. See our iCloud Photos listing guide for photo-library scope.

How is Offload Unused Apps different from the Files app or iCloud storage?

Files app copy markets the Browse file-manager hub — 文件, 浏览. iCloud copy markets cloud disk, backup, or plan quota. Offload Unused Apps copy markets Settings storage management and automatic app binary offload. See our Files app listing guide for file-manager scope.

How is Offload Unused Apps different from App Library?

App Library is the auto-categorized app drawer after the last Home Screen page — 应用资料库. Offload Unused Apps is iPhone Storage management under Settings. See our App Library listing guide for drawer scope.
